summary: SIEM feed s069_single is degraded due to 19.0% duplicate packets (679/3573), well above 5% threshold. All other visibility checks (one-way, truncation, drops, overload, VLAN, encryption, tunnels, oversize) are healthy. Duplicates waste SIEM EPS/license and can skew correlation.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker is aggregating the same traffic from multiple capture points (e.g., overlapping SPANs or SPAN+TAP on same link) without deduplication, forwarding identical copies to the single SIEM tool port.
findings.impact_on_tool: SIEM does not need full payload or bidirectional flow but duplicates inflate EPS, storage and license consumption by ~19%, cause duplicate events/alerts and skew analytics/correlation without improving detection coverage.

recommended_fix.why: Enable packet-broker deduplication on feed s069_single to drop identical packets within a short window before forwarding to the 1G SIEM port, eliminating the 19% overhead while preserving unique events.
